instruction: Use GIMP to save '/home/user/logo.png' as an Encapsulated PostScript (.eps) file.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not support exporting to EPS (Encapsulated PostScript) format. While GIMP can import EPS files, it cannot export to this vector format.
